name: Mandarin Oriental Prague
insider_take: Sleeping in a 14th-century Gothic monastery in the heart of Prague's Lesser Town — the Mandarin Oriental Prague turns history into pure luxury.
whats_special: Housed in a meticulously restored Dominican monastery dating back to 1370, the Mandarin Oriental Prague is a rare blend of medieval Czech heritage and contemporary elegance. The hotel's Spa occupies a former Renaissance chapel — complete with original vaulted ceilings — offering an utterly unique wellness experience. Nestled in the cobblestoned Malá Strana (Lesser Town) district, guests are steps away from the iconic Charles Bridge and Prague Castle, two of Europe's most breathtaking landmarks.
pro_tip: Request a room overlooking the hotel's tranquil garden courtyard for a peaceful retreat from the city buzz — it feels like a secret Prague locals rarely discover.
dont_miss: Dinner at Spices Restaurant , where Asian-inspired cuisine is served beneath centuries-old stone arches. Then stroll five minutes to the Charles Bridge at dawn — before the crowds arrive — for an unforgettable Prague moment.
pros: Prime location in Lesser Town near Prague Castle and Charles Bridge
Restored 14th-century monastery with authentic baroque architecture
Award-winning spa featuring traditional Asian wellness treatments
Exceptional fine dining at Essensia restaurant with Michelin recognition
cons: Limited number of rooms due to historic building constraints
Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive positioning
